definition: a golf club with a thin angled metal head
description: A golf course by the sea at golden hour. A young woman in a cream cap with sunglasses on the peak, a cream polo shirt and beige trousers swings her golf iron through and follows through high over her shoulder. She then laughs and lowers the club. A golden retriever stands beside her with another iron in its mouth next to a white golf bag. Two men in caps watch from behind, one holding up a sheet of paper, with dune grass, seagulls and the sea in soft evening light.
